candidates.change_summary: Delete the require enforcing one guess per address so a subsequent lockInGuess overwrites the stored guess.
Store the bitwise complement of the hash instead of the hash itself.
Delete the assignment of the guess so the stored guess stays zero instead of the provided hash.
Set the target block to block.number instead of block.number + 1, changing the stored block value.
Delete the statement `guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;` so the guess block is never cleared, observable by being unable to lock in a new guess after settling.
Change the payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, observable via the recipient's balance after a winning settle.
Replace the answer computation with the raw block hash instead of its keccak256 digest, changing when a guess matches.
Delete the require that `block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block`, allowing early settlement where blockhash returns 0, observable via revert/success differences.
Delete the first require that the guess block is non-zero, allowing settle to be called with no locked-in guess without reverting.
